notes.summary: TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) compiler and no longer exposes the JS compiler API at the package root. vue-tsc 3.3.14 -> @volar/typescript 2.4.30 requires typescript <7 and @typescript-eslint 8.72.1 requires typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so typecheck and type-aware lint would break.
notes.recheck: do npm view @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@latest peerDependencies and npm view @volar/typescript@latest peerDependencies both accept typescript@7?

notes.summary: Low advisory GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 (prototype poisoning in mergeObject) affects deepmerge >=4.2.0; latest is 4.3.1, no patched release. Build-time only: nuxt -> nitropack -> @rollup/plugin-node-resolve. npm audit's only fix is downgrading nuxt, not allowed.
notes.recheck: has deepmerge published > 4.3.1, or has @rollup/plugin-node-resolve dropped it? (npm view deepmerge version; npm ls deepmerge)

notes.summary: Moderate advisory GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (DoS via globparts amplification) affects minimatch <11.0.1, patched only in the 11 major; eslint 10.14.0, @eslint/config-array 0.23.5, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.1, readdir-glob 3.0.0 and glob 13.0.6 still ask ^10 in their latest releases. Lint/build-time tooling only.
notes.recheck: do the latest eslint, @eslint/config-array, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree and readdir-glob accept minimatch ^11? (npm view <pkg> dependencies.minimatch)

notes.summary: Moderate advisory GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 affects glob >=9.0.0 <=14.0.1; pulled in at build time by nuxt -> nitropack -> @vercel/nft 1.11.0 (latest), which asks glob ^13. Fixed only in 14.0.2.
notes.recheck: does @vercel/nft@latest depend on glob ^14? (npm view @vercel/nft dependencies.glob)
